description:
Post-MVP. Run checks continuously as monitors during interactive development — re-evaluating on file changes and surfacing live pass/fail status, rather than a single batch run. The MVP is a one-shot batch invocation; this introduces a watch loop (file-change triggers), incremental/affected-check evaluation, and a live UI/status surface — a substantial mode shift on top of the batch pipeline.
